speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis/Bladder Pain Syndrome. The clinical picture of chronic bladder pain relieved by voiding, significant frequency, dyspareunia, and negative initial infectious workup is classic for this condition. Given the negative urinalysis and culture, I will not order further imaging at this time as it is typically reserved for ruling out bladder cancer when hematuria is present or for refractory cases. We can proceed with a trial of bladder retraining, dietary modification, and pelvic floor physical therapy.
